pages.the-witness-outlives-the-window.he.text: Dream Records · Sixth Dream Arc · November 1–2, 2026
Joy, flexible vessels, fading memory, and the regenerative meta-witness

Across two nights of dream reporting, power first arrives as joy rather than struggle. A flexible vessel then carries an unfinished journey while perception is still being prepared. The dream sharpens into a continuity problem: writing disappears from a transparent surface while the original witness reads it aloud so another participant can preserve it elsewhere. Victor later recognizes the correspondence with recording fading dreams into durable, attributable archives.
